text: As this report recommends the permanent closure of a portion of a public highway, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services recommends that City Council permanently stop up and close the portions of the public highway municipally known as 6600 Lawrence Avenue East, that are lands north of Lawrence Avenue East and west of Starspray Boulevard, legally described as Parts 1 and 2 on Plan 66R-34623 (the “Subject Lands”). The Subject Lands form part of the Lawrence Avenue East public right-of-way but are not required for current or future municipal transportation purposes. The lands are proposed to be transferred from Transportation Services to Parks and Recreation for the development of a public park and dog off-leash area. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the permanent closure of the portions of the public highway north of Lawrence Avenue East and west of Starspray Boulevard, described as Parts 1 and 2 on Plan 66R-34623, City of Toronto, shown on Attachment 1 to the report (June 22, 2026) from the Acting Deputy General Manager, Transportation Services thereby satisfying the condition precedent established in Delegated Approval Form (DAF) No. 2025-293 for the transfer of operational management of the Subject Lands from Transportation Services to Parks and Recreation. 2.
